comparison.objective: Insert two drawer boxes into separate rails and verify flush closure, rather than commission an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part rail alignment and guided sliding; no small-tool unlocking, fine collar tuning, torque-limited relocking, or response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Both drawers stop in their assigned rails and close flush; setup and scoring tolerances are missing. No dynamic stopping test is required.
comparison.reason: Although both involve constrained motion and an end stop, drawer insertion tests rail alignment, not damping adjustment or energy control.
